headline: Qatar-based youth killed in attack in Dhaka's Sabujbagh
summary: Sifat Ullah, 30, was allegedly hacked to death by a group of men after visiting his girlfriend's house.
details: Sifat Ullah, a 30-year-old man from Dholaipar, who lived and worked in Qatar, was killed on Sunday afternoon in the Sabujbagh area of Dhaka.

The incident occurred around 3:15 PM in Adarsha Para Boroitola. Sifat had visited his girlfriend, a graduate student at Badrunnesa College, student at Badrunnesa College, who lives in her elder sister's house.
According to the victim's girlfriend, a group of 6-7 men, including individuals named Joy, Rajib, and Yasin, entered the house and forcibly dragged Sifat downstairs.
The group then attacked Sifat with sharp weapons, causing severe injuries. Two of the attackers, Rajib and Rajib alias Rabbi, and Yasin, were also injured during the subsequent scuffle.
One of the injured attackers, Rajib, claimed that they entered the house because they had received reports of 'immoral' activities taking place inside.

However, the victim's girlfriend stated that Sifat and she had been in a relationship for two years and were planning to marry. She alleged that Joy, a known local terrorist, used to visit the house for drug use and Sifat had asked him to stop.

Sifat's family, from Dholaipar, Jatrabari, is survived by his father, Zainal Abedin, and two siblings. He was first taken to Mugda General Hospital and later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital, where he died around 6:15 PM.
The body is currently kept at the morgue of Dhaka Medical College for autopsy. Sabujbagh Police Station has been notified of the incident.

headline_marked: 5 arrested in [[death of SB SI in Savar]]
headline: 5 arrested in death of SB SI in Savar
summary: Police have detained five individuals in connection with the killing of a Special Branch Sub-Inspector in Savar.
details: Police have arrested five people in connection with the death of a Special Branch (SB) Sub-Inspector (SI) in Savar.
The arrests were made following an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the officer's death.
Further details regarding the motive and the identities of the suspects have not yet been released.
